setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and GPU replicas
BatchPredictServer_predict: predict on a batch of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM batch splitting and retry logic
BatchPredictServer_call: call the batch predict server with a single AtomicData object to get a prediction dictionary
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system and per-atom prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the batch predict server deployment
